name: tehillah-website
description: Tehillah Community Collaborative website: Next.js frontend and Node.js (Express) backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
